_about: The npm advisories at HIGH or CRITICAL that are known, triaged and accepted, per package directory, each with the reason it is accepted. scripts/check-npm-advisories.mjs fails on any high or critical advisory NOT listed here, and warns on any entry here that no longer appears (remove it: an ignore that outlives its reason is worse than none). Triage of record: docs/security/SCANNER-TRIAGE-2026-10-11.md, section 4.1. Moderate and low advisories are reported by the workflow, never gated.

app.GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm: braces <=3.0.3, no fixed release. Present at runtime only as a dependency of React Native's metro bundler, an auto-installed peer of @solana-mobile/wallet-standard-mobile and of Privy's styled-components; never bundled for the web. Also reached by eslint at lint time on our own globs.
app.GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv: extract-zip <=2.0.1, no fixed release. Dev only: lighthouse -> puppeteer. The Lighthouse gate drives the runner's own Chrome through chrome-launcher, so puppeteer never downloads or unpacks a browser. Cleared by lighthouse 13 (a major bump), when taken.
app.GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r: basic-ftp 5.3.1, fixed only on the 6.x line. Dev only: lighthouse -> puppeteer -> proxy-agent -> get-uri, which requires ^5. The Lighthouse gate opens no FTP connection. Cleared by lighthouse 13, when taken.

backend/reveal.GHSA-3gc7-fjrx-p6mg: bigint-buffer 1.1.5, no fixed release (unmaintained since 2022; the latest @solana/spl-token still requires it). Reached through Irys and Switchboard -> @solana/spl-token -> @solana/buffer-layout-utils. toBigIntLE runs only when decoding SPL token-account amounts; the daemon moves native SOL, and the one spl-token helper Switchboard calls derives an address and decodes nothing.
